p1_b3.ocr: Specifically, the χ2 statistic, alongside its degrees of freedom (df), serves as a fundamental test of the model's goodness-of-fit, indicating how well the proposed model aligns with the observed data. A lower RMSEA value suggests a better fit, with values below 0.06 typically considered indicative of a satisfactory model. Additionally, the comparative fit index (CFI) is included as a benchmark for evaluating model performance, with values approaching 1.0 denoting superior fit.

p1_b4.ocr: Furthermore, the table presents factor correlation, which elucidates the relationships between latent constructs and provides insight into the underlying structure of the data. Collectively, these metrics not only inform the reliability and validity of the single factor but also guide future research directions by highlighting areas for potential model enhancement and refinement.
